Surface fields ``ddic_dco2`` (beta) and ``ddic_dalk`` (eta) with their time

RuntimeParameterSet.description:
Parameters for the execution of the model.

These parameters can be varied (within bounds defined elsewhere in the blueprint, e.g. valid_start/end_date),
without changing the validity of the model solution.

documentation.description: Description of input data provenance; used in provenance roll-up.

hash.title: Hash

start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: End of data time range to be used in the simulation.
end_date.title: End Date

checkpoint_frequency.description:
Time period between creation of checkpoint files.

Supply a string representing the desired time period, such as:
- every day: "1d"
- every week: "1w"
- every month: "1m" or "4w" or "31d"
- every 2.5 days: "2d 12h" or "60h"

A short time period will reduce data re-processing upon restart at the cost
of additional disk usage and compute used for checkpointing.
checkpoint_frequency.title: Checkpoint Frequency

RuntimeParameterSet.title: RuntimeParameterSet

TilingParameterSet.description:
How the domain is split over GPUs, and how the MPI ranks sit on the nodes.

Each of the `n_procs_x * n_procs_y` tiles runs on its own GPU. The GPU model
makes the last `writers_per_node` ranks on every node writer ranks, which
write the output files, so a run takes `tiles + writers_per_node * nodes` MPI
tasks, the same number on every node, and the tiles must divide evenly over
the nodes.

Namelist overrides of the processor grid (`np_xi`/`np_eta` in
`param_settings`) must agree with `n_procs_x`/`n_procs_y`.

documentation.description: Description of input data provenance; used in provenance roll-up.
documentation.title: Documentation

hash.description: Hash used to verify the parameters are unchanged.
hash.title: Hash

n_procs_x.description: Number of tiles along the x-axis.
n_procs_x.title: N Procs X

n_procs_y.description: Number of tiles along the y-axis.
n_procs_y.title: N Procs Y

nodes.description:
Number of nodes the run spans; each holds `n_procs_x * n_procs_y / nodes`
tiles, so it needs at least that many GPUs.
nodes.title: Nodes

writers_per_node.description:
Writer ranks on each node, which write the output files while the GPUs
compute. One per node suits most runs; a large domain writing big history
records may want more (C-Star warns when it judges the count too small).
writers_per_node.title: Writers Per Node

namelist_overrides.description:
Mapping of ROMS namelist group to key/value overrides.

These overrides are layered onto the runtime namelist LAST, after C-Star's
own derived settings, so they take precedence over anything C-Star would
otherwise compute; list values replace the existing list wholesale.

Group and key names are checked against the namelist vocabulary the pinned
gpu-ucla-roms release reads: unknown names are an error when `code.roms`
pins a release, and a warning otherwise. Switches for features the GPU
model does not have are refused. See :class:`TilingParameterSet` for the
processor grid.
namelist_overrides.title: Namelist Overrides
